evidence_items.source_title: MOM parliamentary / public statements on migrant worker inflow and border restrictions
evidence_items.evidence_text: Border restrictions reduced the inflow of migrant workers into Singapore and made it difficult to replace worker outflows.

evidence_items.source_title: MOM comments on sectors affected by reduced migrant worker availability
evidence_items.evidence_text: Construction, marine and process sectors were among the sectors most affected by reduced availability of migrant workers.

evidence_items.source_title: SBF manpower policy paper on foreign workforce constraints
evidence_items.evidence_text: Foreign workforce numbers declined during the pandemic period as border restrictions limited replacement inflows, contributing to manpower constraints for firms.
The observed mechanism is policy-driven labor availability constraint transmitting into operational disruption through reduced manpower availability, project delays, and capacity constraints.
